name: W016 — Cuồng Phong Chiến Đao (Cấp S — Animated 2x2 Spritesheet)
prompt_ref: A single standalone 2D game weapon sprite on a pure solid magenta #FF00FF background, following the attached layout_guide_1x1.png safe zone (centered inside 65% of the canvas, zero border clipping). The weapon is W016 'Cuồng Phong Chiến Đao' (Tempest Gale-Cleaver Greatsword / Stormwind Winged War-Saber, Tier S Epic weapon), placed diagonally from bottom-left (winged silver-bronze pommel at the base of the hilt) to top-right (swept aerodynamic storm-blade tip). Design details: an epic East-meets-West dark-fantasy storm-warrior greatsword featuring a wide, gracefully swept dark mythril and silver-steel blade with aerodynamic wind-channels and glowing emerald-turquoise storm runes etched along the fuller; a swept eagle-wing and cyclone-spiral guard forged from dark bronze and silver housing a glowing emerald-cyan tempest crystal core; and a long two-handed hilt wrapped in dark teal leather and silver wire for Grip 1 and Grip 2. Crisp dark outlines, stylized 2D hand-painted game art matching Arcana Five aesthetic, NO character, NO hands, 100% flat solid #FF00FF magenta background.
prompt_anim_2x2: A 2x2 animated weapon spritesheet (4 frames arranged in 2 rows by 2 columns, following the attached layout_guide_2x2.png grid) on a pure solid magenta #FF00FF background. Each of the 4 cells MUST show the EXACT SAME W016 'Cuồng Phong Chiến Đao' (Tempest Gale-Cleaver Greatsword) from the attached reference weapon image at the EXACT same diagonal angle, scale, and position inside each cell's safe zone (zero border clipping), while animating a 4-frame looping tempest wind-blade aura tightly spiralling around the sword: Frame 1 (top-left) glowing emerald-turquoise storm runes and subtle wind-shear ribbons along the blade; Frame 2 (top-right) swirling cyan-emerald gale vortices and razor wind-crescents surging from the tempest crystal core up the blade; Frame 3 (bottom-left) peak roaring cyclone aura and luminous turquoise wind-slashes enveloping the blade tip; Frame 4 (bottom-right) dissipating emerald slipstream trails cycling smoothly back to Frame 1. Keep the background 100% flat solid #FF00FF magenta with NO grid lines drawn in the final image.
prompt_card: Extreme close-up macro weapon portrait (horizontal rectangular 4:3, 884x632, 100% opaque RGB painting, NO transparent background, NO UI frame). ONE GIANT TEMPEST GALE-CLEAVER GREATSWORD (Cuồng Phong Chiến Đao) identical to the attached reference images MUST FILL 85% OF THE FRAME diagonally from bottom-left (teal leather hilt and winged pommel) to top-right (swept mythril-steel storm blade with glowing emerald-turquoise runes, winged cyclone guard, and swirling cyan-emerald wind-blade vortex aura). Keep the dark-fantasy storm-peak background softly blurred in deep slate-teal clouds so the giant diagonal tempest greatsword is the sole hero subject in the foreground.
